final_recommendation.rationale: The S111/S112/S113 tutoring pilot infrastructure is well-architected and fully tested (129/129 tests), but ZERO real learner data exists. All safety logs, gate logs, and pilot usage logs are in-memory only with no persistence mechanism. Before any expansion beyond internal pilot, the project needs: (1) localStorage persistence for all three log arrays, (2) an export/download mechanism for logs, (3) actual pilot usage with a real learner to validate runtime behavior, (4) log analysis to establish baseline safety block rates and gate violation rates. The default posture stated in the session brief — 'pilot-only / no broad rollout unless evidence supports expansion' — is the only defensible decision given the evidence.
